name: JBL ProAquaTest CO2/pH Permanent
description: A continuous CO2 indicator (drop checker): an indicator fluid in a glass bulb changes colour with dissolved CO2, reading roughly 5–40 mg/L CO2 by hue (blue = low, green = ~optimal ~30 ppm, yellow = high). Reads CO2 indirectly; unlike a reagent kit it gives a constant at-a-glance value.
notes: Lags real CO2 by ~1–2 hours and depends on the indicator fluid's KH; treat the ppm band as approximate. Green is the planted-tank target.
